text: かわいい　かお　して　けっこう　つよい　じゃない

structure.jp: かわいい　かお　して
structure.en: having such a cute face, yet

structure.jp: けっこう　つよい　じゃない

patterns.name: 〜ではないか
patterns.explanation: じゃない at the end, the casual form of ではないか, does not mean 'not' here; it means 'aren't you?' said with surprise. つよい　じゃない = 'you're strong, aren't you'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins the two parts, and here they clash, giving 'even though'. かわいい　かお　して = 'for someone with a cute face'.
